archetype_assessment.current_c1_assessment: The stage-resolved finding is scientifically interesting and evidence-rich, but it currently sits between a pure mechanism/theory paper and a mechanism-derived intervention paper. Because the diagnosed authority mismatch naturally exposes a controllable variable, the cheapest next scientific step is a zero-provider intervention-identifiability D0 rather than more same-support rollout volume.

candidate_method.name: Counterfactual Branch Residual Gating
candidate_method.scientific_residual: The candidate contribution is not factorization or provenance separately. It is measuring the semantic residual induced by counterfactual success/failure reflection of the same byte-identical trajectory and granting only that residual evidence-/target-conditioned actionable authority.

mechanism_diagnosis.actionable_variable: actionable authority granted to reward-branch-specific semantic residuals
mechanism_diagnosis.failure_mode: A single potentially wrong terminal reward bit has undifferentiated authority over the full actionable persistent-memory rewrite, even though much of the reusable procedural content is branch invariant and the branch residual has sparse future decision relevance.
mechanism_diagnosis.finding: Reward-conditioned writing is robust, while branch-specific native uptake and terminal transport are sparse and domain/task dependent.

preserve analysis-only fallback if CBRG D0 or method experiment stops

questions: Can branch-invariant actionable core and branch-specific residual be extracted reproducibly?
Is the residual smaller and more branch-specific than the full memory rather than a restatement of common procedure?
Can target applicability vary non-degenerately over the full frozen support without using terminal outcomes?
Does neutral/core-only memory already capture essentially all actionable content?
Can residual evidence authority be defined from source/trajectory facts without using the reward bit as evidence?
stop_if: neutral/core-only captures essentially all actionable content
residual extraction is unstable or mostly common procedure
direct current work subsumes the exact intervention
zero_call_D0.support: Reuse all archived Shopping and Reddit paired memories and all frozen native targets; do not select known positive downstream cells.

zero_call_D0_observed.decision: Do not authorize provider execution. Demote semantic applicability-only gating to strongest-simple baseline; require an outcome-independent branch-validity signal such as source-evidence support/contradiction and a second zero-call incremental-information check.
